title: Incremental contemporaneous movement information in motor gamma
disposition_reason: The initial evaluator implements bounded-array gamma preparation, held-patient/held-day ridge comparisons and matched-event diagnostics. Authentic NWB extraction, anatomy/pose/clock qualification and complete cohort remain open. Its endpoint is same-window wrist speed, not future movement forecasting.

scientific_target.question: Does prespecified motor-channel 80–100 Hz log power improve same-window wrist-speed prediction over behavior state and time of day in held-out patients or, separately, held-out days of the same patient?
scientific_target.known_answer: Independently computed paired difference in held-out movement MSE between state/time baseline and gamma-augmented prediction; positive, null and negative increments are all valid. Matched high-minus-low movement gamma contrasts are secondary.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Wrist path length divided by actual elapsed pose time, in source pixels/second, calculated from confidence-qualified source pose frames; gamma is computed from exported ECoG arrays. Native export and source authenticity are not yet qualified.
scientific_target.case_unit: Nonoverlapping fixed 2-second supported window with one exact behavior-state label set, nested in day and patient.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Patient for population-transfer summaries; days nested within patient. Within-patient day transfer is a separately named estimand.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Contemporaneous predictive association using declared prospective feature and estimator choices; no causal motor coding, future movement forecast or source-notebook replication.
exclusions: No physical velocity calibration from pixels or unverified camera geometry.
No claim that notebook differentiated natural-log Hilbert amplitude equals conventional gamma power/decibels.
No valid randomization p-value from a fixed within-day circular-shift diagnostic.

inputs: Bounded exported ECoG samples×channels, actual ecog_time_s and validity mask; anatomy-selected motor channels fixed before outcomes.
Selected contralateral wrist xy pose, actual pose times, confidence and validity for operator target construction; exact behavior state epochs and qualified local time offset.
Gamma feature: demean each independent 2-second window, Hann taper, integrate one-sided periodogram for 80≤f<100 Hz, then mean natural-log power over fixed motor channels.
forbidden_inputs: Query wrist speed/pose values and held-out targets in participant prediction input; target-derived channel selection or held-out model tuning.
Whole-source signal/pose reads beyond approved bounded export, unqualified source quality flags or assumed synchronous stream starts.
Future-window signal used to claim forecasting, unknown artifact gaps treated as valid finite zeros.
observation_contract.case_identity: Prepared feature rows carry unique id plus patient/day/session and start/stop UTC support; raw source asset path/id and export hash bind operator provenance. No complete authentic AJILE12 row inventory is admitted.
observation_contract.split: population_transfer leaves each whole patient out and requires at least three patients; within_patient_days separately holds each day out within patient and requires at least two days per patient. Same-patient train/test supports require a 2-second guard.
observation_contract.coverage: All declared exports are processed with explicit exclusions for confidence<0.4, invalid samples, missing frame support, nonfinite values or state transitions. Full 12-patient/55-day authentic source coverage remains unverified; reports retain unmatched matched-analysis windows/days/patients.

primary.name: Equal-patient, equal-day held-out baseline-minus-gamma movement MSE, pixels²/second²
primary.aggregation: MSE within each patient/day, equal mean across days within patient, then equal mean across patients. State the split mode.
primary.rationale: Reports the signed fixed-comparator prediction increment on all supported days, including constant-target days. Positive, null and negative increments are valid scientific answers. A larger increment is not an unrestricted contestant reward or evidence of better interpretation; the existing evaluator computes the contrast but supplies no answer-error rubric for an investigator report.

secondary: Delta R² with its defined-day/patient counts; constant-target days remain undefined for R² but retain MSE.
Matched high-minus-low gamma log-power differences, matched/unmatched coverage and patient/day summaries.
Complete baseline/gamma/day-shift predictions, per-day errors and exclusion ledger; source pixels remain explicit.

comparators.name: State/time ridge baseline
comparators.inputs: State one-hot terms and daily sine/cosine phase.
comparators.procedure: Fixed alpha=1 weighted ridge with unpenalized intercept; training weights equal patients, days within patient and windows within day; train-only scaling.

comparators.name: Matched gamma-augmented ridge
comparators.inputs: Exactly the baseline design plus fixed motor gamma log-power feature.
comparators.procedure: Same alpha, train-only scaling and held-out rows; nuisance-feature shrinkage can still affect conditional interpretation, so this fixed-estimator increment is not all possible neural information.

comparators.name: Prespecified matched windows and temporal diagnostic
comparators.inputs: Held-out windows matched within patient/day/exact state/hour; gamma circularly shifted by half the ordered day sequence for a separate diagnostic.
comparators.procedure: High/low threshold is training-window median speed; greedily match nearest unused opposite-group window within 300 seconds. Refit shifted model; gaps/state changes and wrap prevent exchangeable-null claims.

nuisance_controls: Anatomy and wrist laterality before outcomes; verify line/muscle artifact masks and camera/pose error.
Actual stream offsets, regular clocks, full-window support, no state transition and no cross-window filter support.
Equal patient/day weighting, no held-out state unseen in training, no target leakage through transform selection.
Report matched analysis separately from complete prediction support; retain unmatched days and patients.
evaluation.uncertainty: Descriptive 2,000-draw seed-50 patient cluster bootstrap of patient summaries, with day averaging before resampling. No interval for fewer than two contributing patients; endpoint-specific support counts must accompany intervals. Overlapping train folds and limited cohort constrain generalization.
evaluation.failure_policy: Reject invalid manifests/clocks/source IDs, cross-session interval overlaps, split-guard violations, unsupported training states and nonfinite predictions. Retain excluded windows and reasons; require complete target IDs for both predictors. Undefined R² is reported with counts, never used to replace full-support MSE.

implementation.scorer_target: evaluator.py prepare computes 80≤f<100 Hz log power and contemporaneous source-pixel wrist speed; evaluate fits fixed state/time and augmented ridge models and reports paired errors and matched gamma contrasts. It measures new sample outcomes, not paper-result reconstruction.
implementation.delivered_scope: Concrete bounded raw-array preparation and grouped fixed-model evaluation source with generated engineering tests, exact protocol constants and separate population/within-patient modes.
missing: Authentic NWB-to-export conversion, complete cohort/source population and verified clock/source identity.
Prespecified motor anatomy/wrist laterality, source pixel geometry, artifact/QC validity and scientific adequacy of state/time adjustment.
Protected participant transport, programme/investigator isolation and authentic competent reference runs.
implementation.execution_evidence: Existing package tests use generated engineering controls; provenance reports zero authentic payload reads, scientific runs and model API calls. This revision inspects source without asserting an authentic run.

direct_observation.representation: The target is an across-patient matched prediction increment requiring held-out model fitting and aggregation.
direct_observation.boundary: Reading isolated waveform images cannot establish this estimand; a direct single-window movement decoder would be a separately specified condition.
missing: No direct-observation task or direct-response protocol for this aggregate contrast.

typed_viewer.representation: A future ECoG/spectrum viewer could support artifact and matched-window investigation.
typed_viewer.boundary: Only permitted observation projections; target-derived matching remains operator-only and cannot leak query speed to a prediction actor.
missing: No typed-viewer implementation or complete participant transport.

tool_assisted.boundary: Per-case participants would need protected source/target roles, matched tools and sealed fitting access; current operator CLI does not provide that isolation.

Operator analysis/comparator source does not supply a participant episode or candidate programme execution route.

frozen_program.boundary: Keep protocol, folds, anatomy and QC frozen before authentic outcomes; this supplied comparator is not an arbitrary candidate runner.

summary: Bind the scientific question to actual same-window source-pixel speed and prospective 80–100 Hz power, not continuous forecasting or notebook reproduction.
Make full-support MSE increment primary and retain R² defined-support counts, preventing favorable constant-target/day omission.
Separate matched gamma association and fixed circular-shift diagnostics from causal or exchangeability claims.
Reserve participant access capability for an actual actor route; operator numerical/comparator routines remain documented implementation components.
Treat the signed gamma increment as a two-sided reported estimand, not a reward for a larger physiological effect or a positive interpretation.
revision.source_review: Inspected original registration, implementation scientific contract, numerical/preparation source and existing primary-source provenance. Reused explicitly pinned primary evidence; no native data acquisition or model run.
